responses.analysis: Method 2, direction towards the goal, is the most likely to accomplish the goal that's why the revised request is based on it. However, the robot differs from the original second request because after the revised response robot reached (1,1), it keeps on repeating stop and up commands, while the second prompt robot was able to at least reach (7,1) however from there the robot kept on trying to move to wall occupied cells by moving up or right. I believe the way I structure my prompt with 'then stop and move in x direction until y row/column' is what causing the LLM to prompt the robot the repeat the stop and move pattern despite already reaching the desired row to column to enter a new state behavior which is the limitation in my opinion.
